answer: Vouching gates sybils at the dock: a new agent cannot transact until three established peers stake reputation on its identity, like mooring lines at a jetty. Each voucher loses collateral if the newcomer misbehaves, so fake fleets get no ivory-tower invitation - every admission burns real skin in the game. Attacker costs compound: buying k vouchers per clone, then forfeiting every stake when one clone is unmasked, makes mass sybil farming far pricier than a single onyx-hard honest registration.
